import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int BIG = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 500;

    static class Connection {
        int source, sink, capacity, flow;
        Connection(int s, int t, int cap, int f) {
            source = s;
            sink = t;
            capacity = cap;
            flow = f;
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] obstacles = new boolean[11][11];
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES];
    static List<Connection> network = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] levels = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] nextEdge = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int N, src_r, src_c, T;
    static int[][] dists = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] caps = new int[11][11];

    static int dist(int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, r1, c1});
        int[][] h = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 11; ++j)
                h[i][j] = BIG;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int d = q.peek()[0];
            int x = q.peek()[1];
            int y = q.poll()[2];
            h[x][y] = d;
            if (x > 0 && obstacles[x-1][y]) {
                int nx = x-1, ny = y;
                if (h[nx][ny] > d+1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nx == r2 && ny == c2 && dists[nx][ny] >= d+1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nx == r2 && ny == c2) && dists[nx][ny] > d+1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{d+1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
            if (y > 0 && obstacles[x][y-1]) {
                int nx = x, ny = y-1;
                if (h[nx][ny] > d+1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nx == r2 && ny == c2 && dists[nx][ny] >= d+1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nx == r2 && ny == c2) && dists[nx][ny] > d+1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{d+1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
            if (x < N-1 && obstacles[x+1][y]) {
                int nx = x+1, ny = y;
                if (h[nx][ny] > d+1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nx == r2 && ny == c2 && dists[nx][ny] >= d+1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nx == r2 && ny == c2) && dists[nx][ny] > d+1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{d+1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
            if (y < N-1 && obstacles[x][y+1]) {
                int nx = x, ny = y+1;
                if (h[nx][ny] > d+1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nx == r2 && ny == c2 && dists[nx][ny] >= d+1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nx == r2 && ny == c2) && dists[nx][ny] > d+1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{d+1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return h[r2][c2];
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        network.add(new Connection(u, v, cap, 0));
        network.add(new Connection(v, u, 0, 0));
        adj[u].add(network.size() - 2);
        adj[v].add(network.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean bfs_levels() {
        Arrays.fill(levels, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        levels[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && levels[N*N*2+1] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                int v = network.get(id).sink;
                if (levels[v] == -1 && network.get(id).flow < network.get(id).capacity) {
                    levels[v] = levels[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return levels[N*N*2+1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs_path(int u, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (u == N*N*2+1) return flow;
        for (; nextEdge[u] < adj[u].size(); ++nextEdge[u]) {
            int id = adj[u].get(nextEdge[u]);
            int v = network.get(id).sink;
            if (levels[v] != levels[u] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs_path(v, Math.min(flow, network.get(id).capacity - network.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed != 0) {
                network.get(id).flow += pushed;
                network.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (bfs_levels()) {
            Arrays.fill(nextEdge, 0);
            int delta;
            while ((delta = dfs_path(0, BIG)) > 0) total += delta;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        char c;
        int node = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                c = sc.next().charAt(0);
                dists[i][j] = T;
                if (c == 'Z') {
                    src_r = i;
                    src_c = j;
                    obstacles[i][j] = false;
                } else if (c == 'Y') {
                    obstacles[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    obstacles[i][j] = true;
                }
                connect(0, node++, (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y') ? 0 : c - '0');
            }
        }
        node = N * N + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                c = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') caps[i][j] = c - '0';
                connect(node++, N*N*2+1, (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y') ? 0 : c - '0');
            }
        }
        q.offer(new int[]{0, src_r, src_c});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int d = q.peek()[0];
            int r = q.peek()[1];
            int c_val = q.poll()[2];
            dists[r][c_val] = d;
            if (r > 0 && d + 1 < dists[r - 1][c_val] && obstacles[r - 1][c_val])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r - 1, c_val});
            if (c_val > 0 && d + 1 < dists[r][c_val - 1] && obstacles[r][c_val - 1])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r, c_val - 1});
            if (r < N - 1 && d + 1 < dists[r + 1][c_val] && obstacles[r + 1][c_val])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r + 1, c_val});
            if (c_val < N - 1 && d + 1 < dists[r][c_val + 1] && obstacles[r][c_val + 1])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r, c_val + 1});
        }
        int idx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                int sink_node = N * N;
                ++idx;
                for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                        ++sink_node;
                        if (obstacles[i][j] && obstacles[x][y] && dist(i, j, x, y) <= T)
                            connect(idx, sink_node, BIG);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
